_about: Design-free header menu shared by every concept; generated by tools/build_pages.py from tools/sitemap_data.py (one source of truth: `menu` is the simple Squarespace-safe version, `mega` is the flyout version, both built from the same tier data). Squarespace 7.1 rules: folders are one level deep and a folder label is not a link, so every folder lists an 'Overview' first. Folders cannot nest, so the fallback `menu` promotes the three tiers to top-level folders marked group 'Services' (a concept can render them under one 'Services' label; the mega-menu plugin renders the same three as columns). target_slug is the page the item opens (a live crawl slug, or a proposed page in content/proposed/); also_merges lists live pages the proposal folds into the item; industry examples have in_fallback_menu false (reachable from the Business & Tax Consulting landing; shown in the mega column). Contact and Client Login are single top-level links; one header button.

mega._about: Flyout for the Services item (plan section 4/8): one column per tier with heading, one-line description and links, a 'see all' link per tier. Rendered by a Squarespace mega-menu plugin as a normal page of native blocks, with `menu` as the mobile and no-plugin fallback. One-line summaries are drawn from each page's own text; the tier descriptions are new copy (see proposed/home.json confirm).
